activity_summary: In the afternoon you kept the father on Thursday and the girl on fewer words. You did not write the dawn, the cup, or the tomb. You did not make a part for anyone. The sheet is a note of what the scene is for, not a copy of a printed play.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the limit of the page, and kept to it.
